recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5187 unless the Patient Administration work group separately chooses to revisit the broader Person scope wording introduced after DSTU1.
issue_request: FHIR-5187 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Administration change request for the Person page. It objected to the wording 'A natural person has identity outside of a healthcare setting' and the final resolution changed that line to 'An individual has identity outside of a healthcare setting.'
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in git commit dc2afae9f6e31b220e90a9d948c46e3743363e68, a grouped Person ballot reconciliation commit whose message explicitly included tracker 5187. That commit changed source/person/person-introduction.xml from 'A natural person has identity outside of a healthcare setting' to 'An individual has identity outside of a healthcare setting.'
additional_context: The Person resource is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current source/person/person-introduction.xml no longer contains the exact DSTU1 sentence because c385e310a0370638c7178832f5c6032cdbb26128 later rewrote the Person scope narrative; the replacement describes Person as common demographics for 'an individual (human or animal) across multiple roles.' Current source/person/structuredefinition-Person.xml describes Person as common demographics and administrative information for 'an individual across roles.' Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because current authoritative Person source already avoids the rejected phrase and preserves the approved individual terminology.
